facts.value: Consumes vectors, matrices, scale factors, and hit, hurt, shield, result, and fighter-related collision records. It derives world-space capsule endpoints and overlap or contact results, mutates capsule enable and victim-history state, dispatches collision sounds, and feeds generated transforms, colors, and display-list data to GX for visualization.
facts.rationale: Retain the source-supported unit summary and replace abbreviated, broad prior citations with precise pinned evidence. The unit does not copy all HitCapsule fields in lbColl_CopyHitCapsule; that function copies only victim tables and cursors.

evidence.why: HitCapsule sound fields index the sound table and dispatch audio.
The solver writes closest points, scaled-radius contact position and overlap.
Hurt-capsule world positions are cached and passed to collision solving.
Enable state and victim-table registration, clearing, copying and timer expiry are maintained.
Endpoints, radius, matrices, colors and mesh arrays feed sphere/cylinder GX drawing.

facts.value: Implements shared runtime geometry and visualization for Melee's combat collision bubbles, including offensive hitboxes, damageable hurtboxes, shields, reflectors, absorbers, and other capsule-shaped regions.
facts.rationale: Retain game mapping using local runtime behavior and independently read canonical fighter call sites for shield, reflector and absorber categories. Rendered aliases are not category evidence.

evidence.why: HitResult sphere wrapper uses shield_hit and writes collision contact/overlap.
Enabled HurtCapsule wrapper calls the shared solver.
Shared GX renderer emits sphere ends and cylinder body.
Fighter caller passes canonical reflect_hit, absorb_hit and shield_hit fields to corresponding wrappers.
